def get_protein_isoforms(gene_id):
    url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/elink.fcgi?dbfrom=gene&id={gene_id}&linkname=gene_protein_refseq&retmode=json"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
        data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
        linkset = data['linksets'][0]
        protein_ids = [l for l in linkset.get('linksetdbs', [{}])[0].get('links', [])]
    
    url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi?db=protein&id={','.join(map(str, protein_ids))}&retmode=json"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
        data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
        return [(data['result'][str(pid)]['accessionversion'], data['result'][str(pid)]['title'], data['result'][str(pid)]['slen']) for pid in protein_ids]
